description: This Java class 'CmpMerge' provides a command-line tool for merging multiple '.cmp' KiCad component mapping files into a single output file. It reads source files, extracts relevant content, and writes combined data, adding a header and footer for the merged file.

classes.name: CmpMerge
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to merge '.cmp' files, containing a main method for execution from command line.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the utility; processes command-line arguments, reads source files, and writes a merged output file.

methods.name: readFileToList
methods.description: Reads a given file into a list of strings, each representing a line from the file.

methods.name: checkExistence
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists; terminates the program if the file is missing.
